system.description:
Range 120ft; a volume of up to one 10ft cube per four levels (max 5 cubes).

  • Choose one: (1) reshape inanimate, nonmagical earth, stone, wood or metal into any shape (permanent); (2) conjure one nonmagical object worth up to 100 gp per caster level; it lasts 1 day per level and is plainly conjured, so it cannot be sold; (3) make one illusion of 4th level or lower real for 1 minute per level, so its effects (damage, barriers) work as that spell says.
  • Cannot affect living creatures or magic items. No save.

Classes: Illusionist
